entries.notes: Source attribution: verified against port (port citations retained as secondary); upstream reference: src/LuaType/LuaTArray.cpp; 11/11 method citations resolved in the upstream tree (per-method citations in upstream_implementation) [2026-10-07 conformance fix] No Lua-callable TArray constructor exists in either tree: TArray userdata is created only when an array-typed UObject property is read (src/LuaType/LuaUObject.cpp push_arrayproperty Operation::Get -> TArray::construct). There is no Length()/Add()/Get(); element access is __index/__newindex (1-based) and length is GetArrayNum() or #a (__len). Out-of-bounds __index reads AND all __newindex writes grow the live array via AddZeroed (src/LuaType/LuaTArray.cpp prepare_to_handle) -- i.e. they mutate game memory, which is why the live conformance battery only reads in-bounds elements and skips element writes.
